Parses pod config into Firedancer and Frankendancer structs, with renamed-option checks.

# Purpose
This C file implements configuration extraction from a POD data source into internal configuration structures. It defines three entry points: [`fd_config_extract_podh`](<#fd_config_extract_podh>), [`fd_config_extract_podf`](<#fd_config_extract_podf>), and `fd_config_extract_pod`, which read values from `pod` and fill `fd_configh_t`, `fd_configf_t`, and `fd_config_t` objects. The code uses the `CFG_POP` family of macros to read many typed fields, including strings, integers, booleans, arrays, and table entries. It covers configuration areas such as paths, logging, gossip, consensus, RPC, snapshots, network settings, tile settings, capture, replay, archiver, and development options.

The file also handles version and layout differences between Firedancer and Frankendancer configurations by selecting different field sets based on `config->is_firedancer`. It validates some values, such as `paths.snapshots`, checks for renamed options with `CFG_RENAMED`, and rejects leftover POD entries with `fdctl_pod_find_leftover`. This file is part of the configuration loading path and defines internal parsing logic rather than a public API.
